# Reut Shachnai

::: {.divider}
:::

## I’m a cognitive scientist studying barriers that undermine children’s motivation and how to reduce them to help children thrive.

I am a PhD candidate in the Department of Psychology at Yale University.

[Download CV](cv.pdf){.button}

:::

## Research Interests {#research}

My work explores the social and cognitive factors that shape children’s motivation. I am especially interested in how children’s social worlds, including the adults who raise and teach them, can support or undermine their persistence, curiosity, and learning.
